request.style: English, male baritone solo with warm choir backing, acoustic guitar, upright bass, fiddle, piano, soft percussion, humble and reflective mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A dispute arose between the disciples
And a Jew about cleansing and law
They came to John to ask
Who is this one across the Jordan now
Bearing witness but now baptized
Everyone is going to him instead

[Chorus]
No one can receive anything
Unless it has been given from heaven above
I am not the Christ I said clearly
But I have been sent ahead of him

[Verse]
The one who has the bride is the bridegroom
The friend stands and listens for his voice
Rejoicing greatly at the sound
This is my joy and it is complete

[Chorus]
No one can receive anything
Unless it has been given from heaven above
I am not the Christ I said clearly
But I have been sent ahead of him

[Bridge]
He must increase
I must decrease
He must increase
I must decrease

[Chorus]
No one can receive anything
Unless it has been given from heaven above
I am not the Christ I said clearly
But I have been sent ahead of him

[Outro]
He must increase
I must decrease
